description: 仓库资源模型：Project 声明多仓库与 mo repo 命令组

tasks.title: Server: repository domain policy, grain, and API routes
tasks.description: Implement the repository declaration lifecycle in the Project aggregate: a pure domain policy for validation and transitions, ProjectGrain changes for repository-backed creation, add, metadata-only update, set-default, and default-delete rejection, plus the HTTP route contracts under /api/projects/{projectRef}/repositories.
acceptanceCriteria: Project grain and API specs cover default-invariant preservation, case-insensitive duplicate rejection, metadata-only update, idempotent default selection, and default-deletion conflict
Repository-less Project creation is rejected with a validation error
The query model returns the repository flagged as default; no silent fallback to list order
Actionable error envelopes are returned for validation, duplicate, conflict, and not-found cases
tasks.output: Server domain policy, grain, API routes, DTOs, and related specs/unit tests
tasks.notes: Reuses the existing RepositoryInfo / ProjectInfo.Repositories shape and strengthens invariants rather than adding new persistence.

tasks.title: Server: startup repository data upgrade
tasks.spec: specs/project-management/spec.md#Existing Projects upgrade without repository metadata loss
tasks.description: Add an idempotent startup upgrade invoked after Migrate() and before StartAsync that reads every Project's RepositoriesJson, validates and normalizes declarations using the T-001 domain policy, and writes all changes in one transaction; aborts with Project-level diagnostics for unrecoverable data.
acceptanceCriteria: Single-repository legacy Projects are upgraded with that repository as default
Projects with no default are normalized to the first declaration as default
Projects with multiple defaults keep only the first marked default
Declaration order, names, Git URLs, and base branches are preserved
Unrecoverable data (empty list, missing fields, case conflicts) stops startup with actionable diagnostics and leaves rows unchanged
Project and Issue identities remain unchanged; no schema or Runner protocol change
tasks.output: Startup upgrade task and related data-upgrade specs
tasks.notes: Uses the same domain policy as live mutations so default-selection rules cannot diverge.

tasks.title: CLI: mo project create --path
tasks.spec: specs/repository-cli-commands/spec.md#`mo project create` bootstraps the default repository from a Git path
tasks.description: Implement `mo project create <name> --path <path>` to resolve the initial repository declaration locally from the Git work tree, then call the repository-backed creation API. Reject missing or invalid paths before issuing HTTP requests.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid Git path creates a Project with one default repository
Missing `--path` returns an actionable validation error and exits non-zero
Invalid path (not a Git repo, missing origin, no branch) returns an actionable error and exits non-zero
The local path is never sent to or persisted by the server
CLI project command specs pass
tasks.output: CLI project create command, Git bootstrap helper, and related specs
tasks.notes: Git inspection stays in the CLI to avoid server-side path dependencies.

tasks.title: CLI: mo repo command group
tasks.spec: specs/repository-cli-commands/spec.md#`mo repo` provides the complete project repository command surface
tasks.description: Implement the complete `mo repo list/add/update/set-default/delete` surface with project scoping, `--output table|json`, default marking, and actionable errors. `update` rejects identity/default options; `delete` surfaces the default conflict from the server.
acceptanceCriteria: `list` marks the default in table and exposes `isDefault` in JSON
`add` with `--set-default` switches the default atomically; omitted base branch defaults to `main`
`update` requires at least one metadata option and rejects `--new-name`/`--set-default`
`set-default` is idempotent on the current default
`delete` on a non-default repository succeeds; `delete` on the default exits non-zero and tells the user to `set-default` first
All errors identify the Project or repository and exit non-zero
CLI repository command specs pass
tasks.output: CLI repository commands, repository table renderer, and related specs
tasks.notes: T-003 and T-004 are independent CLI tasks that can run in parallel after T-001.
